InboxIQ — See it in action

Email in. Tasks out.

Paste any email. InboxIQ extracts your tasks, summarises the thread and drafts a reply.

Input — Email
FROM: John Smith · 18 June
RE: Job 4471 — won't book at weld
Could you have a look at the job below? It won't let us book it at weld — materials show as available but the system won't allow it.

Don't book it through if you figure it out. It has to be an HPC-trained welder that books it.

Thanks, John
InboxIQ
Output — Summary & Tasks
Chain Summary
John flagged that job 4471 won't book at weld despite materials showing available. Needs investigating — only an HPC-trained welder can book it through.
JOB 4471 — WELD BOOKING
Investigate why job 4471 won't book at weld despite materials showing as available
High
Draft Reply
Looked into it — materials are flagged under the wrong sub-batch. Sorting it now and will confirm once it's bookable. Won't book it through myself.
The Problem

Work arrives from too many directions at once.

Every email, meeting and interruption creates an action. Most of them get lost.

Actions get buried in threads

Requests get buried in threads and forgotten.

Nothing tells you what matters first

Without a system, urgency beats importance every time.

Follow-ups fall through the cracks

No reminder means no follow-up. Things fall through.

You become the system

Memory is not a task management system.

How InboxIQ Works

Simple by design.

1

Set your context

Tell InboxIQ what's critical today. It uses this every time it reads an email.

2

Paste an email

One message or a full thread. InboxIQ pulls out exactly what belongs to you.

3

Review tasks and replies

Tasks arrive prioritised. A draft reply is ready to send.

4

Track everything

Mark tasks as waiting, set reminders, see what's overdue instantly.

What's Included

Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

Email task extraction
Paste any email. Your actions come out as clear, direct tasks.
Draft replies
A plain-language reply ready to check and send with every task.
Chain summaries
Understand any thread in seconds without re-reading the whole thing.
Context Board
Add operational context once. InboxIQ factors it into every task.
Waiting status
Note who you're waiting on and get flagged automatically when it's due.
Task aging
Stale tasks are flagged so nothing quietly goes cold.
Snapshot dashboard
